title: Understanding charge separation in CdS/Ce-UiO66-NH2 heterojunctions for enhanced photocatalytic hydrogen evolution
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01473A, Paper

Wenqing Hou, Sam A. J. Hillman, Soranyel Gonzalez-Carrero, Shilin Yao, Huangtianzhi Zhu, James R. Durrant
The enhanced H2 evolution efficiency of the CdS/Ce-UiO-NH2 heterojunction is attributed to its ability to generate long-lived (ms) charges. In contrast with Zr-UiOs, Ce-UiO-NH2 acts as the electron donor in this heterojunction.
